A standing whisper of curvature along a mapped hundred-mile lee shore, softening what storm surge can pile against it — W-07's harbor palm at a scale only Eq. 3.1g's dials distinguish from it. Maintained by a coastal league whose member cities each fund one segment's re-survey; the one recorded segment default is why the league's charter now begins with the flooding it caused. Working form (Eq. 8.231): Curv(g)_LG06(r) = Curv(g)(r) [Eq. 4.12], t_dom -> t_dom_legend t_recert = t_recert_0 * eta_LG06 Working form of Eq. 4.23 for The Gentle Coast (LG-06): eta_LG06 is the standing work's upkeep factor.

[LG-07] The Deep Anchor (Legend). A Bound Singularity (Eq. 4.12) sunk beneath a strait as a standing tidal engine, its shell recertified (Eq. 4.23) by a hereditary college of tide-wardens. The strait's currents run the mills of three nations; the college answers to all three and, by its founding compact, to none of them alone — the directory's standing example of what a Held Star's politics look like when the star is load-bearing. Working form (Eq. 8.232): Xi_overlay_LG07(A, B) = Xi_overlay(A, B) [Eq. 4.1], t_dom -> t_dom_legend t_drift = L_dom / v_survey * eta_LG07 Working form of Eq. 4.22 for The Deep Anchor (LG-07): eta_LG07 is the standing work's upkeep factor.

[LG-08] The Orchard Perpetual (Legend). A valley under standing reversed dilation — months outside, years inside — where slow-maturing groves, vintages, and timber pass decades in a season. The Quiet Vault's mirror twin, held by a sibling order, and the two institutions' shared re-survey calendar is the closest thing metric-sector practice has to a professional journal. Working form (Eq. 8.233): Xi_overlay_LG08(A, B) = Xi_overlay(A, B) [Eq. 4.1], t_dom -> t_dom_legend t_drift = L_dom / v_survey * eta_LG08 Working form of Eq. 4.22 for The Orchard Perpetual (LG-08): eta_LG08 is the standing work's upkeep factor.

[LG-09] The Sky Harbor (Legend). A standing region of eased weight above a plateau city where cargo rises on winch-lines no engine drives — a curvature well inverted, held open as public infrastructure for a century and a half. Its recertification interval is set by the plateau's own erosion; the city's stonemasons and its metric-order share one guildhall, which every visiting scholar remarks upon and every resident finds unremarkable. Working form (Eq. 8.234): Curv(g)_LG09(r) = Curv(g)(r) [Eq. 4.12], t_dom -> t_dom_legend t_recert = t_recert_0 * eta_LG09 Working form of Eq. 4.23 for The Sky Harbor (LG-09): eta_LG09 is the standing work's upkeep factor.

[LG-10] The Border That Persuades (Legend). A frontier march under a standing, mild gradient — every step across it heavier than the last for a mapped dozen miles — raised by a Legend whose realm wanted no wall. Armies can cross it; nothing about crossing it is worth it, which was the design brief in full. Its maintaining order is, by treaty, staffed from both sides of it — the mathematics is indifferent to direction, and the treaty's drafters were not fools. Working form (Eq. 8.235): Curv(g)_LG10(r) = Curv(g)(r) [Eq. 4.12], t_dom -> t_dom_legend t_recert = t_recert_0 * eta_LG10 Working form of Eq. 4.23 for The Border That Persuades (LG-10): eta_LG10 is the standing work's upkeep factor.

[AS-03] The Thousandth Alloy (Beyond Legend). The life's work of a Demiurge aspirant who proved one extrapolation rule r along a single mixing family and drove N_family (Eq. 4.25) past a thousand verified, never-before-observed stable alloys — several of which underpin whole trades today. Records treat the work with the exact double edge Eq. 4.25 predicts: complete mastery of one proven rule, and by the aspirant's own surviving marginal note, "no nearer the rule of rules than the day I began." Working form (Eq. 8.236): N_family_AS03 = |Gen_partial(dM)| along one proven rule r Working form of Eq. 4.25 for The Thousandth Alloy (AS-03): the fragment's measured closeness proxy.

[AS-04] The Widening Ring (Beyond Legend). A Cosmographer aspirant's forty-year campaign to push one closed-form domain outward, ring by re-proven ring, driving rho_cosmo (Eq. 4.26) to the highest value ever independently audited. The campaign's own ledgers are the historical proof of §1.4's cruelty: each ring's cost is recorded, each exceeds the last, and the final entry prices the next ring at more than all forty years combined. The aspirant stopped. The ledger, historians note, does not say failed. Working form (Eq. 8.237): Coh_tetrarch_AS04 = average of Chi(f1, f2) over the pairs the aspirant held, -> 1 never reached Working form of Eq. 4.24 for The Widening Ring (AS-04): the fragment's measured closeness proxy.

[AS-05] The Sixfold Silence (Beyond Legend). A second Tetrarch fragment, complementary to AS-01: an aspirant who, rather than chaining the six Chi pairs at speed, held all six simultaneously quiescent — a standing readiness in which any pair could express without preamble, sustained for a legendary afternoon. Witnesses swore the four forces "waited on her like servants in one hall." Eq. 4.24's verdict is unchanged by the elegance: six couplings in perfect agreement are six couplings, and k_unified remained, as ever, unwritten. Working form (Eq. 8.238): Coh_tetrarch_AS05 = average of Chi(f1, f2) over the pairs the aspirant held, -> 1 never reached Working form of Eq. 4.24 for The Sixfold Silence (AS-05): the fragment's measured closeness proxy.

[AS-06] The Unfinished Chorus (Beyond Legend). The cautionary completion of AS-02's story: a later Communion that attempted to hold its merged boundary standing rather than dissolve after one casting. N_comm (Eq. 4.27) exceeded every prior record for eleven days. The surviving accounts of the dissolution are sealed by the three orders that keep them, and the directory records only what all three publish jointly: that dM_total is a union of provers, not proofs; that the members were recovered as members; and that no Communion since has petitioned to try. --- Working form (Eq. 8.239): N_comm_AS06 = | dM_total | / | dM_legend_typical | Working form of Eq. 4.27 for The Unfinished Chorus (AS-06): the fragment's measured closeness proxy.

[N-EM-26] Shaded Lamp (Novice, EM). Lumen Thread's glow (N-EM-03) shaped to shine into a narrow arc and nowhere else — light for the page that shows nothing to the window. The directional shaping is the skill: the same delta(F_EM), sculpted rather than merely held. Standard issue, informally, to every clerk who has ever worked past a garrison's curfew. Working form (Eq. 8.240): S_detect(x, t) = k_EM * dAe_nearby(x, t) * eta_NEM26 -- read-only; nothing is sourced Working form of Eq. 4.0e for Shaded Lamp (N-EM-26): eta_NEM26 is the caster's trained sensitivity in one setting; a passive read costs nothing and this is the only number in it that can be improved.

[N-EM-27] Clear Pane (Novice, EM). A whisper of warmth held across glass — a window, a lens, a lighthouse light — keeping frost and breath-fog from forming at all. The rare heating technique judged entirely by what the observer doesn't see, which is why lighthouse keepers examine candidates on it in winter, at night, without warning. Working form (Eq. 8.241): S_detect(x, t) = k_EM * dAe_nearby(x, t) * eta_NEM27 -- read-only; nothing is sourced Working form of Eq. 4.0e for Clear Pane (N-EM-27): eta_NEM27 is the caster's trained sensitivity in one setting; a passive read costs nothing and this is the only number in it that can be improved.

[N-EM-28] Bellows' Ghost (Novice, EM). A moving column of warmed air driven across a forge bed or malting floor — Eq. 4.0a applied to air in motion rather than a body at rest. Holding heat in something that leaves is the training value; smiths call a caster who can't yet do it "still heating the room." Working form (Eq. 8.242): S_detect(x, t) = k_EM * dAe_nearby(x, t) * eta_NEM28 -- read-only; nothing is sourced Working form of Eq. 4.0e for Bellows' Ghost (N-EM-28): eta_NEM28 is the caster's trained sensitivity in one setting; a passive read costs nothing and this is the only number in it that can be improved.

[N-EM-29] Bearing Sense (Novice, EM). The formalized discipline built atop Ripple Sense (N-EM-05), exactly as Eq. 4.0e's write-up predicted someone would build it: reading not just that aether moves nearby but roughly whence — the read taken at both ears' distance apart, so to speak, and the difference judged. Still a pure passive read, still costless (Eq. 4.0e); the directory catalogs it because every tradition teaches it and no two agree who invented it. Working form (Eq. 8.243): S_detect(x, t) = k_EM * dAe_nearby(x, t) * eta_NEM29 -- read-only; nothing is sourced Working form of Eq. 4.0e for Bearing Sense (N-EM-29): eta_NEM29 is the caster's trained sensitivity in one setting; a passive read costs nothing and this is the only number in it that can be improved.

[N-EM-30] Cook's Even Hand (Novice, EM). Eq. 4.0a spread deliberately flat across a pan or griddle's whole face — no hot center, no raw rim. The domestic sibling of N-EM-20's diffuse hold, and the standard second-year exercise for exactly the same reason: even is harder than strong. Working form (Eq. 8.244): S_detect(x, t) = k_EM * dAe_nearby(x, t) * eta_NEM30 -- read-only; nothing is sourced Working form of Eq. 4.0e for Cook's Even Hand (N-EM-30): eta_NEM30 is the caster's trained sensitivity in one setting; a passive read costs nothing and this is the only number in it that can be improved.

[N-EM-31] Smokeless Torch (Novice, EM). A staff-head glow bright enough to walk by, held for a full watch — Lumen Thread scaled up and toughened against the holder's own jostling stride. The casting every night-courier actually uses, catalogued separately from N-EM-03 because sustaining a glow while moving is a distinct and harder discipline. Working form (Eq. 8.245): S_detect(x, t) = k_EM * dAe_nearby(x, t) * eta_NEM31 -- read-only; nothing is sourced Working form of Eq. 4.0e for Smokeless Torch (N-EM-31): eta_NEM31 is the caster's trained sensitivity in one setting; a passive read costs nothing and this is the only number in it that can be improved.

[N-EM-32] Iron Cry (Novice, EM). Lodestone Touch (N-EM-08) cast on a sweeping tool rather than a needle — dropped pins, nails, and blade-shards leap from floorboards and hay to the magnetized head. Seamstresses' shops and stables both keep the technique in the family; the guilds have given up asserting jurisdiction. Working form (Eq. 8.246): P_in = -k_EM * Fid * Ae_local^2 * eta_NEM32 -- reverse-sign casting T(t_hold) = T_0 - |P_in| * t_hold * D_cycle / (m_t * c_p) Working form of Eq. 4.0a for Iron Cry (N-EM-32): eta_NEM32 is the fraction of the drawn heat the target can give up without frosting, which is what keeps the casting honest.

[N-EM-33] Chill Draught (Novice, EM). Cold Ember (N-EM-02) worked through a sickroom's air rather than a body or a drink — a few degrees of relief held through a fever's worst night. Physicians rank it with N-EM-14 and N-WK-04 as the Novice sickroom triad, and casting schools teach the three together under that name. Working form (Eq. 8.247): P_in = -k_EM * Fid * Ae_local^2 * eta_NEM33 -- reverse-sign casting T(t_hold) = T_0 - |P_in| * t_hold * D_cycle / (m_t * c_p) Working form of Eq. 4.0a for Chill Draught (N-EM-33): eta_NEM33 is the fraction of the drawn heat the target can give up without frosting, which is what keeps the casting honest.

[N-EM-34] Storm Bleed (Novice, EM). A slow, deliberate discharge trickled from a mast-top, steeple, or standing crane down to ground as a storm builds — charge spent quietly before the sky can spend it loudly. Harbor and cathedral wardens keep the technique on their storm rosters; the directory notes that it does not make lightning impossible, merely bored. Working form (Eq. 8.248): S_detect(x, t) = k_EM * dAe_nearby(x, t) * eta_NEM34 -- read-only; nothing is sourced Working form of Eq. 4.0e for Storm Bleed (N-EM-34): eta_NEM34 is the caster's trained sensitivity in one setting; a passive read costs nothing and this is the only number in it that can be improved.

[N-EM-35] Ember Purse (Novice, EM). A single coal held alive at the bottom of a lined pouch for a day's march — Eq. 4.0a at its absolute minimum output, plus patience. Predates written casting instruction in every tradition that has looked; several curricula still open with it on the grounds that their founders did. Working form (Eq. 8.249): S_detect(x, t) = k_EM * dAe_nearby(x, t) * eta_NEM35 -- read-only; nothing is sourced Working form of Eq. 4.0e for Ember Purse (N-EM-35): eta_NEM35 is the caster's trained sensitivity in one setting; a passive read costs nothing and this is the only number in it that can be improved.

[N-EM-36] Scholar's Constant (Novice, EM). A reading light held not merely steady but unvarying — no flicker, no drift, for hours. Copyists and illuminators pay the premium over candles gladly; oculists prescribe it; casting examiners love it, because any wobble in Fid is instantly, publicly visible in the light itself. Working form (Eq. 8.250): S_detect(x, t) = k_EM * dAe_nearby(x, t) * eta_NEM36 -- read-only; nothing is sourced Working form of Eq. 4.0e for Scholar's Constant (N-EM-36): eta_NEM36 is the caster's trained sensitivity in one setting; a passive read costs nothing and this is the only number in it that can be improved.

[N-EM-37] Thawline (Novice, EM). Gentle warmth walked along a path, stoop, or gutter-run, clearing ice without the salt that kills the spring garden. Municipal casting rosters in cold cities list it as the season's bulk work; Novices bill it by the paced yard. Working form (Eq. 8.251): S_detect(x, t) = k_EM * dAe_nearby(x, t) * eta_NEM37 -- read-only; nothing is sourced Working form of Eq. 4.0e for Thawline (N-EM-37): eta_NEM37 is the caster's trained sensitivity in one setting; a passive read costs nothing and this is the only number in it that can be improved.

[N-EM-38] Curing Cave (Novice, EM). Chill Locker (N-EM-09) scaled to a cheese shed, hanging room, or root cellar and held through the warm months — the largest-volume cold-hold in the Novice tier, and the standard endurance benchmark on the cold side, as Sun's Patience (N-EM-22) is on the warm. Working form (Eq. 8.252): S_detect(x, t) = k_EM * dAe_nearby(x, t) * eta_NEM38 -- read-only; nothing is sourced Working form of Eq. 4.0e for Curing Cave (N-EM-38): eta_NEM38 is the caster's trained sensitivity in one setting; a passive read costs nothing and this is the only number in it that can be improved.

[N-EM-39] Current Taste (Novice, EM). A passive read (Eq. 4.0e) taken before touching — a wire, a rail, a cloud-watching mast, another caster's apparatus — for the live charge it may carry. Costless, sourceless, and responsible, linemen's guilds attest, for more working careers reaching retirement than any technique in this catalog. Working form (Eq. 8.253): S_detect(x, t) = k_EM * dAe_nearby(x, t) * eta_NEM39 -- read-only; nothing is sourced Working form of Eq. 4.0e for Current Taste (N-EM-39): eta_NEM39 is the caster's trained sensitivity in one setting; a passive read costs nothing and this is the only number in it that can be improved.

[N-EM-40] Traveler's Hearthline (Novice, EM). Soaked boots, cloaks, and blankets dried overnight by a low, even warmth threaded through the drying rack. Inns advertise a caster on staff with a boot-shaped sign; the sign is older than three of the languages it appears in. Working form (Eq. 8.254): S_detect(x, t) = k_EM * dAe_nearby(x, t) * eta_NEM40 -- read-only; nothing is sourced Working form of Eq. 4.0e for Traveler's Hearthline (N-EM-40): eta_NEM40 is the caster's trained sensitivity in one setting; a passive read costs nothing and this is the only number in it that can be improved.

[N-EM-41] Star Point (Novice, EM). A single brilliant mote thrown high and held burning for a slow count — position, distress, or rally here, visible for miles. The discharged counterpart to Signal Thread's held code (N-EM-21); every military manual pairs them on the same page. Working form (Eq. 8.255): S_detect(x, t) = k_EM * dAe_nearby(x, t) * eta_NEM41 -- read-only; nothing is sourced Working form of Eq. 4.0e for Star Point (N-EM-41): eta_NEM41 is the caster's trained sensitivity in one setting; a passive read costs nothing and this is the only number in it that can be improved.

[N-EM-42] Glassblower's Patience (Novice, EM). A gathered glass mass held at working heat between furnace trips — minutes bought at the bench that the furnace would otherwise reclaim. Catalogued at Novice with a standing note: this holds heat in glass; shaping the glass itself is AR-05's eigenvector and no part of this casting, a distinction glass-shops drill because the confusion is an Eq. 4.17 story waiting to happen. Working form (Eq. 8.256): P_in = -k_EM * Fid * Ae_local^2 * eta_NEM42 -- reverse-sign casting T(t_hold) = T_0 - |P_in| * t_hold * D_cycle / (m_t * c_p) Working form of Eq. 4.0a for Glassblower's Patience (N-EM-42): eta_NEM42 is the fraction of the drawn heat the target can give up without frosting, which is what keeps the casting honest.

[N-EM-43] Ice-House Debt (Novice, EM). Deep, sustained chill poured into an icehouse's mass in high summer — spending a day's casting to extend a season's store. The bulk-work counterpart to N-EM-16's cupful; ice merchants contract it by the hundredweight preserved, audited at autumn opening. Working form (Eq. 8.257): P_in = -k_EM * Fid * Ae_local^2 * eta_NEM43 -- reverse-sign casting T(t_hold) = T_0 - |P_in| * t_hold * D_cycle / (m_t * c_p) Working form of Eq. 4.0a for Ice-House Debt (N-EM-43): eta_NEM43 is the fraction of the drawn heat the target can give up without frosting, which is what keeps the casting honest.

[N-EM-44] Needle Unsworn (Novice, EM). The reverse-sign casting of Lodestone Touch: magnetization removed from a tool, blank, or instrument part that has picked it up unwanted. Instrument-makers cast it before every fine assembly; navigators cast it on everything near the binnacle and trust nothing anyway. Working form (Eq. 8.258): L_out = k_EM * Fid * Ae_local(t) * eta_NEM44 -- held, not discharged Working form of Eq. 4.0a for Needle Unsworn (N-EM-44): eta_NEM44 is how much of the distortion comes out as visible light rather than warmth, which the caster sets by how narrowly the glow is shaped.

[N-EM-45] Dry Keeping (Novice, EM). A sealed cask, chest, or powder store held a few degrees above the damp — tinder that strikes, biscuit that snaps, paper that takes ink. The unglamorous warm-side twin of N-EM-38, and the technique quartermasters actually mean when they requisition "a caster for the stores." Gravity (k_grav) — extends Eq. 4.0b. Working form (Eq. 8.259): L_out = k_EM * Fid * Ae_local(t) * eta_NEM45 -- held, not discharged Working form of Eq. 4.0a for Dry Keeping (N-EM-45): eta_NEM45 is how much of the distortion comes out as visible light rather than warmth, which the caster sets by how narrowly the glow is shaped.

[N-GR-19] Even Pour (Novice, Gravity). A falling stream — grain into a hopper, sand into a mold, shot into a bag — lightened just enough to slow and smooth its pour. Millers and founders use it daily; casting instructors prize it as the tier's best drill for holding an effect on a continuous target rather than an object. Working form (Eq. 8.260): F_net = m_t * g_local * (1 + k_grav * Fid * eta_NGR19) -- reverse-sign casting Working form of Eq. 4.0b for Even Pour (N-GR-19): eta_NGR19 is how much of the added weight lands on the target's footing rather than its middle, which is what makes it hold.

[N-GR-20] Ringer's Ease (Novice, Gravity). The great bell lightened through the hard first pulls of swing-up, released once momentum owns the work. Bell towers with a caster among the band ring heavier bells than their ropes deserve; the release timing, as with N-GR-13, is the entire examination. Working form (Eq. 8.261): F_net = m_t * g_local * (1 + k_grav * Fid * eta_NGR20) -- reverse-sign casting Working form of Eq. 4.0b for Ringer's Ease (N-GR-20): eta_NGR20 is how much of the added weight lands on the target's footing rather than its middle, which is what makes it hold.

[N-GR-21] Diver's Stone (Novice, Gravity). A descent-weight held heavy on the way down and released at depth — one casting, one hold, one letting-go, in the dark, under pressure of both kinds. Pearl and sponge divers rate casters by how exactly the release lands; the directory rates the technique as N-GR-13's discipline with higher stakes. Working form (Eq. 8.262): F_net = m_t * g_local * (1 + k_grav * Fid * eta_NGR21) -- reverse-sign casting Working form of Eq. 4.0b for Diver's Stone (N-GR-21): eta_NGR21 is how much of the added weight lands on the target's footing rather than its middle, which is what makes it hold.

[N-GR-22] Ladder Faith (Novice, Gravity). Anchor Step's increase (N-GR-02) cast on a ladder's feet rather than the climber's. The climber climbs unencumbered; the ladder simply declines to walk. Catalogued beside N-GR-12 as the pair every building trade teaches its first-years in their first week. Working form (Eq. 8.263): F_net = m_t * g_local * (1 + k_grav * Fid * eta_NGR22) -- reverse-sign casting Working form of Eq. 4.0b for Ladder Faith (N-GR-22): eta_NGR22 is how much of the added weight lands on the target's footing rather than its middle, which is what makes it hold.

[N-GR-23] Assayer's Stillness (Novice, Gravity). A fine balance's pans made fractionally heavier, damping their swing to a fast, honest rest. Weigh-houses cast it before every disputed measure; the directory notes with approval that both parties customarily watch the casting, which is precisely why it is done. Working form (Eq. 8.264): F_net = m_t * g_local * (1 + k_grav * Fid * eta_NGR23) -- reverse-sign casting Working form of Eq. 4.0b for Assayer's Stillness (N-GR-23): eta_NGR23 is how much of the added weight lands on the target's footing rather than its middle, which is what makes it hold.

[N-GR-24] Warding Fall (Novice, Gravity). Feather Fall (N-GR-01) held ready over a drop that someone frail, small, or reckless is near — a contingency hold in J-28's sense, but within a single casting: the window is open, the effect waits on the fall. Nurses, scaffold foremen, and the parents of climbing-aged children make up its entire clientele, which is to say most of the world. Working form (Eq. 8.265): F_net = m_t * g_local * (1 + k_grav * Fid * eta_NGR24) -- reverse-sign casting Working form of Eq. 4.0b for Warding Fall (N-GR-24): eta_NGR24 is how much of the added weight lands on the target's footing rather than its middle, which is what makes it hold.

[N-GR-25] Picker's Yoke (Novice, Gravity). Light Load (N-GR-03) on a full basket, pail, or hod across the carry that fills it — the load lightened while being added to, which is the catalogued difficulty. Harvest crews and hod-carriers drill it; the technique's test is that the hold must not lapse at the moment more weight arrives. Working form (Eq. 8.266): F_net = m_t * g_local * (1 + k_grav * Fid * eta_NGR25) -- reverse-sign casting Working form of Eq. 4.0b for Picker's Yoke (N-GR-25): eta_NGR25 is how much of the added weight lands on the target's footing rather than its middle, which is what makes it hold.

[N-GR-26] Mire Step (Novice, Gravity). Light Load on the caster's own steps across bog, mudflat, or rotten ice — Ford Keeper's (N-GR-16) exact opposite, catalogued as its pair. Fen-country guides hold both and choose per crossing; choosing wrong is the region's oldest joke and occasional obituary. Working form (Eq. 8.267): F_net = m_t * g_local * (1 + k_grav * Fid * eta_NGR26) -- reverse-sign casting Working form of Eq. 4.0b for Mire Step (N-GR-26): eta_NGR26 is how much of the added weight lands on the target's footing rather than its middle, which is what makes it hold.

[N-GR-27] Ridgepole Rise (Novice, Gravity). Light Load on a roof-tree or truss through the raising, from ground to seat. The mason has N-GR-18; this is the carpenter's, and barn-raising country treats a visiting caster's afternoon as payment for a winter of dinners. Working form (Eq. 8.268): F_net = m_t * g_local * (1 + k_grav * Fid * eta_NGR27) -- reverse-sign casting Working form of Eq. 4.0b for Ridgepole Rise (N-GR-27): eta_NGR27 is how much of the added weight lands on the target's footing rather than its middle, which is what makes it hold.

[N-GR-28] Long Portage (Novice, Gravity). A boat lightened on its bearers' shoulders between waterways — held, walking, for however long the path insists. The voyageur's one indispensable casting; brigades log portage times with and without, and recruit accordingly. Working form (Eq. 8.269): F_net = m_t * g_local * (1 + k_grav * Fid * eta_NGR28) -- reverse-sign casting Working form of Eq. 4.0b for Long Portage (N-GR-28): eta_NGR28 is how much of the added weight lands on the target's footing rather than its middle, which is what makes it hold.

[N-GR-29] Deadfall's Word (Novice, Gravity). Anchor Step's increase on a trap's drop-weight or a pile-driver's ram at the moment of release — the fall made committed, faster and truer than gravity alone would insist. The directory catalogs the pile-driver use; the trapper use is older and the technique keeps the trapper's name. Working form (Eq. 8.270): F_net = m_t * g_local * (1 + k_grav * Fid * eta_NGR29) -- reverse-sign casting Working form of Eq. 4.0b for Deadfall's Word (N-GR-29): eta_NGR29 is how much of the added weight lands on the target's footing rather than its middle, which is what makes it hold.

[N-GR-30] Flywheel's Memory (Novice, Gravity). A potter's wheel, grindstone, or lathe-wheel rim made temporarily heavier, storing steadier momentum through uneven work. Turners call the effect "borrowed patience"; examiners call it the cleanest demonstration that N-GR-02's equation never cared whether its target was still. Working form (Eq. 8.271): F_net = m_t * g_local * (1 + k_grav * Fid * eta_NGR30) -- reverse-sign casting Working form of Eq. 4.0b for Flywheel's Memory (N-GR-30): eta_NGR30 is how much of the added weight lands on the target's footing rather than its middle, which is what makes it hold.

[N-GR-31] Belayer's Root (Novice, Gravity). Anchor Step on the holder of the rope rather than the climber on it. Mountain schools teach it before any technique aimed at the climber themselves, on the argument — carved over one school's door — that the mountain is climbed by the one who doesn't fall. Working form (Eq. 8.272): F_net = m_t * g_local * (1 + k_grav * Fid * eta_NGR31) -- reverse-sign casting Working form of Eq. 4.0b for Belayer's Root (N-GR-31): eta_NGR31 is how much of the added weight lands on the target's footing rather than its middle, which is what makes it hold.

[N-GR-32] Festival Rise (Novice, Gravity). Paper lanterns, petals, or streamers lightened at release to climb far past their means. Pure ornament, catalogued without apology: by headcount of witnesses, likely the most seen gravity casting in the world, and many casters' first public work. Working form (Eq. 8.273): F_net = m_t * g_local * (1 + k_grav * Fid * eta_NGR32) -- reverse-sign casting Working form of Eq. 4.0b for Festival Rise (N-GR-32): eta_NGR32 is how much of the added weight lands on the target's footing rather than its middle, which is what makes it hold.

[N-GR-33] Plow's Bite (Novice, Gravity). Anchor Step's increase on a plowshare through baked or root-bound ground. The team pulls no harder; the iron argues better. Field casters bill it by the furlong, and the directory notes it has quietly ended more disputes with heavy soil than any tier above it. Strong (k_strong) — extends Eq. 4.0c. Working form (Eq. 8.274): F_net = m_t * g_local * (1 + k_grav * Fid * eta_NGR33) -- reverse-sign casting Working form of Eq. 4.0b for Plow's Bite (N-GR-33): eta_NGR33 is how much of the added weight lands on the target's footing rather than its middle, which is what makes it hold.

[N-ST-18] Line's Reprieve (Novice, Strong). Seal Bind (N-ST-01) along a frayed span of rope or cable, holding the damaged length trustworthy until the splice can be made. Patch Press's (N-ST-06) rigging sibling, carried under the same rule: a reprieve is a promise, and harbor authorities audit standing ones. Working form (Eq. 8.275): E_bind_eff = E_bind * (1 - k_strong * Fid * eta_NST18) -- reverse-sign casting, along the grain Working form of Eq. 4.0c for Line's Reprieve (N-ST-18): eta_NST18 is how well the weakened line follows the grain rather than crossing it; a good caster scores, a poor one shatters.

[N-ST-19] Netmender's Faith (Novice, Strong). Knot Faith (N-ST-05) cast across a net's whole working panel at the haul — hundreds of small crossings held as one binding. The volume, not the strength, is the catalogued skill; crews rate a caster by how big a panel they can hold honest through a heavy catch. Working form (Eq. 8.276): E_bind_eff = E_bind * (1 - k_strong * Fid * eta_NST19) -- reverse-sign casting, along the grain Working form of Eq. 4.0c for Netmender's Faith (N-ST-19): eta_NST19 is how well the weakened line follows the grain rather than crossing it; a good caster scores, a poor one shatters.

[N-ST-20] Icebreaker's Line (Novice, Strong). Brittle Ease (N-ST-02) walked along river ice ahead of a channel cut — Quarry Line's (N-ST-15) winter twin, point by patient point. Ferry towns open their season with it; impatient towns open theirs a casting early and a boat short. Working form (Eq. 8.277): E_bind_eff = E_bind * (1 - k_strong * Fid * eta_NST20) -- reverse-sign casting, along the grain Working form of Eq. 4.0c for Icebreaker's Line (N-ST-20): eta_NST20 is how well the weakened line follows the grain rather than crossing it; a good caster scores, a poor one shatters.

[N-ST-21] Surgeon's Thread (Novice, Strong). Seal Bind at sutures, holding a closed wound's stitches against the body's first restless days. Cast, like N-ST-10, only alongside a mender's instruction, and catalogued with the same standing note: the casting is Novice, the judgment is not. Working form (Eq. 8.278): E_bind_eff = E_bind * (1 - k_strong * Fid * eta_NST21) -- reverse-sign casting, along the grain Working form of Eq. 4.0c for Surgeon's Thread (N-ST-21): eta_NST21 is how well the weakened line follows the grain rather than crossing it; a good caster scores, a poor one shatters.

[N-ST-22] Drawer's Grace (Novice, Strong). Brittle Ease at the grip of a rooted thing — a bad tooth, a rusted spike, a fence post set by someone's proud grandfather — for a clean pull instead of a broken one. Toothdrawers gave it its name; every other trade that pulls things borrowed it and kept the name out of respect or amusement. Working form (Eq. 8.279): E_bind_eff = E_bind * (1 - k_strong * Fid * eta_NST22) -- reverse-sign casting, along the grain Working form of Eq. 4.0c for Drawer's Grace (N-ST-22): eta_NST22 is how well the weakened line follows the grain rather than crossing it; a good caster scores, a poor one shatters.

[N-ST-23] Cobbler's Week (Novice, Strong). Seal Bind through new boots' seams and sole-stitching across the breaking-in — the boot yields to the foot while the work holds. Marching regiments contract it by the company, and cobblers' guilds, after a century of grumbling, now examine for it. Working form (Eq. 8.280): E_bind_eff = E_bind * (1 - k_strong * Fid * eta_NST23) -- reverse-sign casting, along the grain Working form of Eq. 4.0c for Cobbler's Week (N-ST-23): eta_NST23 is how well the weakened line follows the grain rather than crossing it; a good caster scores, a poor one shatters.

[N-ST-24] Grindstone True (Novice, Strong). Eq. 4.0c through a spinning grindstone's bulk against the burst that speed invites. The wheel-shop safety casting, held for the duration of every hard run; insurance clubs in three cities discount premiums for shops that keep a caster on the stone. Working form (Eq. 8.281): E_bind_eff = E_bind * (1 - k_strong * Fid * eta_NST24) -- reverse-sign casting, along the grain Working form of Eq. 4.0c for Grindstone True (N-ST-24): eta_NST24 is how well the weakened line follows the grain rather than crossing it; a good caster scores, a poor one shatters.

[N-ST-25] Shake-Rider (Novice, Strong). Brittle Ease down a cedar or oak bolt's rays, riving shingles and lath true off the froe. Green Split's (N-ST-04) finer-grained cousin; shake-makers call the difference "asking the tree politely," and the directory can improve neither the phrase nor the technique. Working form (Eq. 8.282): E_bind_eff = E_bind * (1 - k_strong * Fid * eta_NST25) -- reverse-sign casting, along the grain Working form of Eq. 4.0c for Shake-Rider (N-ST-25): eta_NST25 is how well the weakened line follows the grain rather than crossing it; a good caster scores, a poor one shatters.

[N-ST-26] Binder's Press (Novice, Strong). Seal Bind across a sewn book-block while glue and cords set — N-ST-17's logic at the bindery bench, holding signatures square through the cure. Scriptoria schedule it as the wheelwrights do, by the drying afternoon; apprentice casters read while they hold, which both trades approve. Working form (Eq. 8.283): E_bind_eff = E_bind * (1 + k_strong * Fid * eta_NST26) -- over the seam's area A_t only Working form of Eq. 4.0c for Binder's Press (N-ST-26): eta_NST26 is the seam's area against the whole object's; the boost is spent on the line that leaks.

[N-ST-27] Wellstone Guard (Novice, Strong). Shatterguard's hold (N-ST-09) cast down a well or cistern lining while someone works below it. The stones were sound this morning; the casting is for the afternoon. Well-diggers' first rule names it: no descent unwarded, and the rule is old enough to scan in verse. Working form (Eq. 8.284): E_bind_eff = E_bind * (1 + k_strong * Fid * eta_NST27) -- over the seam's area A_t only Working form of Eq. 4.0c for Wellstone Guard (N-ST-27): eta_NST27 is the seam's area against the whole object's; the boost is spent on the line that leaks.

[N-ST-28] Knapper's Consent (Novice, Strong). Chisel's Consent (N-ST-07) carried to flint, chert, and obsidian's conchoidal moods — the flake eased off its chosen plane and no other. The oldest stone trade's newest tool; master knappers accept it grudgingly, use it precisely, and still check the edge by eye, thumb, and oath. Working form (Eq. 8.285): E_bind_eff = E_bind * (1 + k_strong * Fid * eta_NST28) -- over the seam's area A_t only Working form of Eq. 4.0c for Knapper's Consent (N-ST-28): eta_NST28 is the seam's area against the whole object's; the boost is spent on the line that leaks.

[N-ST-29] Sea-Chest Seal (Novice, Strong). Seal Bind around a chest, cask, or magazine lid's seam for a passage's leg — watertight by casting until made watertight by craft. Pursers log standing seals by berth and renewal date; the log's name aboard most hulls is simply the promises. Working form (Eq. 8.286): E_bind_eff = E_bind * (1 + k_strong * Fid * eta_NST29) -- over the seam's area A_t only Working form of Eq. 4.0c for Sea-Chest Seal (N-ST-29): eta_NST29 is the seam's area against the whole object's; the boost is spent on the line that leaks.

[N-ST-30] Fished Mast (Novice, Strong). Seal Bind through a sprung spar and its lashed splints — the sailor's fishing of a wounded mast, held from the casting until a yard's honest repair. The open-water sibling of N-ST-06 and N-ST-18, and the entry most often cited in wreck inquiries under casting, absence of. Working form (Eq. 8.287): E_bind_eff = E_bind * (1 + k_strong * Fid * eta_NST30) -- over the seam's area A_t only Working form of Eq. 4.0c for Fished Mast (N-ST-30): eta_NST30 is the seam's area against the whole object's; the boost is spent on the line that leaks.

[N-ST-31] Tent Against Gale (Novice, Strong). Eq. 4.0c through canvas, guys, and seams as the weather arrives — the whole shelter bound as one cloth for the blow's duration. Expedition casters hold it in shifts; the directory notes that the technique's true test, every tradition agrees, is casting it calmly. Working form (Eq. 8.288): E_bind_eff(t) = E_bind * (1 + k_strong * Fid * eta_NST31) for t < t_hold, then released Working form of Eq. 4.0c for Tent Against Gale (N-ST-31): eta_NST31 is how much of the standing load the boosted bind carries, held for exactly as long as the danger lasts.

[N-ST-32] Kiln Prop (Novice, Strong). Shatterguard's logic carried into the fire: saggars, shelves, and props bind-boosted through a firing's stress hours. Potteries schedule the casting with the fuel; AR-27's porcelain guild famously staffs it with Novices and pays them like Journeymen, which the directory records as both fact and hint. Weak (k_weak) — extends Eq. 4.0d. The tier's standing caution — faint by nature, easy to underestimate — carries forward from Expansion I unchanged. Working form (Eq. 8.289): E_bind_eff(t) = E_bind * (1 + k_strong * Fid * eta_NST32) for t < t_hold, then released Working form of Eq. 4.0c for Kiln Prop (N-ST-32): eta_NST32 is how much of the standing load the boosted bind carries, held for exactly as long as the danger lasts.

[N-WK-13] Reckoner's Touch (Novice, Weak). A calibrated decay nudge into old bone, ash, or timber, with the response's strength read against a reckoner's table — a crude age-of-remains estimate, honest to the nearest generation or so. Courts admit it as corroboration, never proof; scholars use it to decide which digging is worth a Master's Audit (M-18). Working form (Eq. 8.290): Gamma_eff = Gamma_0 * (1 + k_weak * Fid * eta_NWK13) t_cure = t_cure_0 * Gamma_0 / Gamma_eff Working form of Eq. 4.0d for Reckoner's Touch (N-WK-13): eta_NWK13 is how much of the cure's slow chemistry answers to the nudge; some processes barely do, and the entry says so.

[N-WK-14] Firefly Ink (Novice, Weak). Nudge-responsive mineral ink that answers a later touch with a soft glow — night-legible orders, boundary-stones that name themselves to a caster's hand, marginalia meant for one reader. Deep Mark's (N-WK-08) portable descendant, and the quiet favorite of every courier service with secrets. Working form (Eq. 8.291): Gamma_eff = Gamma_0 * (1 + k_weak * Fid * eta_NWK14) t_cure = t_cure_0 * Gamma_0 / Gamma_eff Working form of Eq. 4.0d for Firefly Ink (N-WK-14): eta_NWK14 is how much of the cure's slow chemistry answers to the nudge; some processes barely do, and the entry says so.

[N-WK-15] Cinder Sentinel (Novice, Weak). A nudge swept through a dead-looking ash heap, spoil pile, or burned-over field — live pockets answer with a glow the eye would never find. Fire-watches cast it behind every extinguished blaze; the technique is credited by name in more city fire codes than any other Novice entry. Working form (Eq. 8.292): Gamma_eff = Gamma_0 * (1 - k_weak * Fid * eta_NWK15) -- reverse-sign casting t_spoil = t_spoil_0 * Gamma_0 / Gamma_eff Working form of Eq. 4.0d for Cinder Sentinel (N-WK-15): eta_NWK15 is how much of the target's decay the nudge can reach; a whole cask answers less than a single seal.

[N-WK-16] Retting Nudge (Novice, Weak). Quick Ripen's logic (N-WK-01) turned to flax and hemp in the retting pond — the fiber's release hastened by days, the stink's tenure mercifully shortened. Linen country holds it as N-WK-06's equal in the year's round, and both smell like money to those who cast them. Working form (Eq. 8.293): Gamma_eff = Gamma_0 * (1 - k_weak * Fid * eta_NWK16) -- reverse-sign casting t_spoil = t_spoil_0 * Gamma_0 / Gamma_eff Working form of Eq. 4.0d for Retting Nudge (N-WK-16): eta_NWK16 is how much of the target's decay the nudge can reach; a whole cask answers less than a single seal.

[N-WK-17] Silage Keep (Novice, Weak). Slow Larder (N-WK-03) at fodder scale — the pit or rick's spoilage slowed through the margin weeks between a thin winter and a lost herd. Pastoral districts roster their weak-force Novices for it the way grain districts roster granary work; the two rosters, famously, trade casters at the equinoxes. Working form (Eq. 8.294): Gamma_eff = Gamma_0 * (1 - k_weak * Fid * eta_NWK17) -- reverse-sign casting t_spoil = t_spoil_0 * Gamma_0 / Gamma_eff Working form of Eq. 4.0d for Silage Keep (N-WK-17): eta_NWK17 is how much of the target's decay the nudge can reach; a whole cask answers less than a single seal.

[N-WK-18] Angler's Star (Novice, Weak). Faint Ward-Light on a float, night-line, or trap-marker — a glow that rides the water and cannot drown. The Novice ancestor of AD-39's harbor-scale blend, catalogued as such; fisherfolk, asked about the lineage, reliably answer that the Adepts borrowed it from them. Working form (Eq. 8.295): Gamma_eff = Gamma_0 * (1 - k_weak * Fid * eta_NWK18) -- reverse-sign casting t_spoil = t_spoil_0 * Gamma_0 / Gamma_eff Working form of Eq. 4.0d for Angler's Star (N-WK-18): eta_NWK18 is how much of the target's decay the nudge can reach; a whole cask answers less than a single seal.

[N-WK-19] Mushroom Bed Quicken (Novice, Weak). Compost Quicken's nudge (N-WK-06) tuned to a spawn bed's slower appetite — cultivated mushrooms brought to flush days early, cellar by cellar. A city technique, oddly: catalogued from the capital's cellar-farms, where casters and growers are usually the same person. Working form (Eq. 8.296): Gamma_eff = Gamma_0 * (1 - k_weak * Fid * eta_NWK19) -- reverse-sign casting t_spoil = t_spoil_0 * Gamma_0 / Gamma_eff Working form of Eq. 4.0d for Mushroom Bed Quicken (N-WK-19): eta_NWK19 is how much of the target's decay the nudge can reach; a whole cask answers less than a single seal.

[N-WK-20] Bathhouse Stones (Novice, Weak). Hearthstone (N-WK-04) at civic scale — a bath's stone bank nudged to a faint, steady warmth that carries the day between firings. Bathhouses in fuel-poor towns budget the casting against the wood it saves; the arithmetic, posted by law in two provinces, favors the caster embarrassingly. Working form (Eq. 8.297): Gamma_eff = Gamma_0 * (1 - k_weak * Fid * eta_NWK20) -- reverse-sign casting t_spoil = t_spoil_0 * Gamma_0 / Gamma_eff Working form of Eq. 4.0d for Bathhouse Stones (N-WK-20): eta_NWK20 is how much of the target's decay the nudge can reach; a whole cask answers less than a single seal.

[N-WK-21] Vigil Chain (Novice, Weak). A row of faint ward-lights kindled in sequence through the night, each new glow marking a watch's turn — the hours made visible down a wall, a ward, a harbor front. Long Watch's (N-WK-10) institutional form; garrisons that keep it say the chain is for the watchers, and widows say otherwise, and both are right. Working form (Eq. 8.298): Gamma_eff = Gamma_0 * (1 - k_weak * Fid * eta_NWK21) -- reverse-sign casting t_spoil = t_spoil_0 * Gamma_0 / Gamma_eff Working form of Eq. 4.0d for Vigil Chain (N-WK-21): eta_NWK21 is how much of the target's decay the nudge can reach; a whole cask answers less than a single seal.

[N-WK-22] Quarantine Mark (Novice, Weak). A ward-light glow worked into a door-mark that cannot be doused, scrubbed off, or quietly painted over — only outwaited, at the mark's own slow fading. Plague ordinances in every major port specify it; the directory records, without further comment, that its casters are paid double and thanked never. Working form (Eq. 8.299): Gamma_eff = Gamma_0 * (1 - k_weak * Fid * eta_NWK22) -- reverse-sign casting t_spoil = t_spoil_0 * Gamma_0 / Gamma_eff Working form of Eq. 4.0d for Quarantine Mark (N-WK-22): eta_NWK22 is how much of the target's decay the nudge can reach; a whole cask answers less than a single seal.

[J-48] Lighthouse Round (Journeyman). N-EM-27 on the lamp-glass, N-EM-34 down the tower as weather builds. Clear the light, bleed the sky, in alternation all night; the keeper's log marks which window was open when, and inspectors read it like scripture. Working form (Eq. 8.300): X_seq(t) = X_NEM27(t) * Win_1(t) + X_NEM34(t) * Win_2(t) Win_1(t) . Win_2(t) = 0 t_round = N_rep * (w_1 + w_2) + (2 * N_rep - 1) * tau_switch Working form of Eq. 4.13 for Lighthouse Round (J-48): the two windows carry N-EM-27 and N-EM-34; the round is timed by tau_switch alone.

[J-49] Icehouse Summer (Journeyman). N-EM-43 into the mass at dawn, N-ST-29 on the door-seal at close. Chill, then seal — never together, and the merchant's ledger thanks the discipline twice. [J-50] Steeplejack's Creed (Journeyman). N-GR-22 at the ladder's foot, then N-GR-24 held over the drop while aloft. Faith below, warding above; the trade's oath names both windows in order and apprentices recite it at the first rung. [J-51] Fenland Post Round (Journeyman). N-GR-26 across the mire, N-EM-31 through the dark miles after. The fen courier's pairing; the choice of which window opens at dusk's edge is the district's standing interview question for new riders. [J-52] Foundry Pour Sequence (Journeyman). N-GR-19 steadying the metal's fall, then N-ST-24 on the mold-wheel taking it. Pour window closed before spin window opens — a cadence called aloud, because molten metal forgives less than examiners do. [J-53] Sickroom Night (Journeyman). N-EM-33 through the air, N-WK-04 at the feet, in turn as the fever argues. The Novice sickroom triad's third member (N-EM-14) opens between them as a read — three windows, strictly disjoint, and the physician's real skill is the order. [J-54] Bell Founder's Proof (Journeyman). N-EM-14's pulse through the cooling casting, then N-ST-24's hold as the bell is first swung. Read, then guard; the trade's saying — listen before you let it speak — is Eq. 4.13 wearing an apron. Working form (Eq. 8.306): X_seq(t) = X_NEM14(t) * Win_1(t) + X_NST24(t) * Win_2(t) Win_1(t) . [J-55] Night Harbor Watch (Journeyman). N-WK-18 on the far buoys or N-EM-41 when a hull comes in wrong. The either/or is the discipline: the star is spent the moment it flies, and a watch that flares at every shadow guards nothing by midnight. Weight window, ward window, never both; tenders keep the count aloud, and the count is the technique. Working form (Eq. 8.308): X_seq(t) = X_NGR21(t) * Win_1(t) + X_NST27(t) * Win_2(t) Win_1(t) . [J-57] Winter Stores Round (Journeyman). N-EM-45 through the dry stores, N-WK-17 at the silage, walked in turn each dusk. The quartermaster's pairing across two forces and two kinds of patience; garrison manuals list it under duties, unglamorous, essential. Reprieve, then removal — same force, opposite signs, and the walk's master watching that the windows never touch. [J-59] Orchard Night Round (Journeyman). N-WK-01 along the early rows at dusk, N-WK-22's cousin-mark on the blighted trees for morning's axe. Ripen the sound, mark the sick; the pairing behind AD-34's blend, held here the honest Journeyman way — one window at a time. [J-60] Raising Day (Journeyman). N-GR-27 under the ridgepole, then N-ST-08 through the pegs as it seats. Lift window closed, lock window open, on the foreman's single word; barn country holds the word itself to be the technique's true name. The founding Legend's civic gift; the maintaining order re-surveys ward by ward on a rota older than the city's parishes, and the city's masons, famously, still rope and scaffold as if the mercy were not there — which the order's charter, in its first clause, requires them to be taught. [LG-15] The Drowned Star (Legend). A Bound Singularity (Eq. 4.12) held beneath a strait's approaches, its worked currents a standing defense no fleet has ever forced — LG-07's tidal engine turned to a realm's lock and key. Its tide-wardens recertify the shell (Eq. 4.23) on a cadence set by treaty among the powers it deters, which the directory records as the tier's driest joke and soundest peace. Working form (Eq. 8.432): Xi_overlay_LG15(A, B) = Xi_overlay(A, B) [Eq. 4.1], t_dom -> t_dom_legend t_drift = L_dom / v_survey * eta_LG15 Working form of Eq. 4.22 for The Drowned Star (LG-15): eta_LG15 is the standing work's upkeep factor.

[LG-16] The Raised River (Legend). A river carried along a ridgeline in a standing channel of eased and guided weight — an aqueduct of curvature, watering three duchies from a valley none of them owns. Its drift-order's re-survey cadence follows the river's own silt; the water-law that grew around the working fills nine volumes, and the working itself, one line of Eq. 3.1g's dials, which the jurists cite with visible resentment. Working form (Eq. 8.433): Xi_overlay_LG16(A, B) = Xi_overlay(A, B) [Eq. 4.1], t_dom -> t_dom_legend t_drift = L_dom / v_survey * eta_LG16 Working form of Eq. 4.22 for The Raised River (LG-16): eta_LG16 is the standing work's upkeep factor.

[LG-17] The Hanging Terraces (Legend). A mountain city's fields stacked in standing eased-weight tiers — soil, water, and harvest carried on curvature where no slope would hold them. The granary of a cold kingdom and the tier's most inhabited working: ten thousand people farm inside it daily. Its maintaining order examines Wardens into its service by the hundred-year ledger, and promotes, by charter, only the bored — vigilance, their maxim runs, is a habit, not a mood. Working form (Eq. 8.434): Curv(g)_LG17(r) = Curv(g)(r) [Eq. 4.12], t_dom -> t_dom_legend t_recert = t_recert_0 * eta_LG17 Working form of Eq. 4.23 for The Hanging Terraces (LG-17): eta_LG17 is the standing work's upkeep factor.

[LG-18] The Far-Seeing Ridge (Legend). A border ridge under a standing lens of curvature — light's own paths bent so the watchtowers see over the horizon's argument, a march's whole approach laid open to plain sight. The subtlest working in the tier's catalog: nothing moves, nothing weighs less, and nothing crosses unseen. Its drift-order are surveyors to a soul; their re-validation cadence is the starfield itself, read nightly against the lens, which the directory notes is Eq. 4.22 practiced as astronomy. Working form (Eq. 8.435): Curv(g)_LG18(r) = Curv(g)(r) [Eq. 4.12], t_dom -> t_dom_legend t_recert = t_recert_0 * eta_LG18 Working form of Eq. 4.23 for The Far-Seeing Ridge (LG-18): eta_LG18 is the standing work's upkeep factor.

[AS-07] The Unnamed Orchard (Beyond Legend). A Demiurge aspirant's proven extrapolation rule along one living family: cultivar after cultivar derived from solved stock, each verified, none ever before grown — N_family (Eq. 4.25) driven high through orchards rather than alloys. The estate still bears fruit no wild lineage explains. The aspirant's final notebook closes the fragment as AS-03's did, in different ink: the rule's family fed a province; the rule of rules fed nothing but the wanting of it. Working form (Eq. 8.436): N_family_AS07 = |Gen_partial(dM)| along one proven rule r Working form of Eq. 4.25 for The Unnamed Orchard (AS-07): the fragment's measured closeness proxy.

[AS-08] The Ceded Ring (Beyond Legend). A Cosmographer aspirant who, confronting AS-04's ledger, tried the other ledger line: releasing proven domain at one edge to afford extension at another — rho_cosmo (Eq. 4.26) held constant while its shape was walked across a continent over a lifetime. The campaign proved a bitter theorem the equations had merely implied: the propagator's self-dependence (Eq. 1.4) taxes the release too. Ground given back does not un-complicate what its solving complicated. The ring moved; the price compounded; the fragment stands as the path's second ledger, and its lesson is the first ledger's, twice. Working form (Eq. 8.437): Coh_tetrarch_AS08 = average of Chi(f1, f2) over the pairs the aspirant held, -> 1 never reached Working form of Eq. 4.24 for The Ceded Ring (AS-08): the fragment's measured closeness proxy.

chunks.t: AS-09 The Weather of One Hand
chunks.x: [AS-09] The Weather of One Hand (Beyond Legend). A Tetrarch fragment complementary to AS-01's speed and AS-05's stillness: an aspirant who expressed one modest effect — a held warmth over a winter camp — through each of the four forces in rotation, nightly, for a season, indistinguishably to everyone warmed. Witnesses could not say which force served on which night; Eq. 4.24's audit could, which is the fragment's whole content. Four servants in perfect livery are not one master, however long the season — and the camp, the records note, was warm all the same. Working form (Eq. 8.438): Coh_tetrarch_AS09 = average of Chi(f1, f2) over the pairs the aspirant held, -> 1 never reached Working form of Eq. 4.24 for The Weather of One Hand (AS-09): the fragment's measured closeness proxy.

[AS-10] The Two-Mind Bridge (Beyond Legend). The smallest Communion in the historical record: two lifelong collaborators who pooled their proven domains (Eq. 4.27) for a bounded working season each year, dissolving cleanly each autumn, for forty-one years. N_comm barely exceeded one middling Sovereign's measure; nothing about it was vast. The fragment is catalogued for what the sealed accounts of AS-06 are not: a Communion entered, held, and ended, repeatedly, by two minds that remained two. The traditions that keep the record disagree on whether it marks the path's one safe door or its subtlest warning, and the directory — as with every question this tier asks — records the disagreement and closes the catalog. Working form (Eq. 8.439): rho_cosmo_AS10 = R_dom_achieved / R_dom_legend_typical Working form of Eq. 4.26 for The Two-Mind Bridge (AS-10): the fragment's measured closeness proxy.

Ae: The aether field (defined in Eq. 3.1)
A_op: The reality-selection amplitude the Grand Equation evaluates (defined in Eq. 3.1)
Loop_dM[...]: Path-integral selection restricted to the caster's comprehension domain dM (defined in Eq. 3.1)
Dpath(Ae): Integration measure over aether field configurations (defined in Eq. 3.1)
hbar: Action quantum setting the phase scale of the path integral (defined in Eq. 3.1, Eq. 4.4)
k_f: Coupling constant, force *f* ∈ {EM, weak, strong, gravity} (defined in Eq. 3.1c)
F_f: Field-strength tensor for force *f* (defined in Eq. 3.1c)
q, q_bar: Quark field and its Dirac conjugate (defined in Eq. 3.1d)
C_sel: Coupling-type selector (scalar/vector/tensor) — legacy symbol; no longer appears in any equation (defined in Foundational draft; retained conceptually within M_op (Eq. 3.1d/3.1e))
M_op: Mass operator (matrix form) acting on the quark field (defined in Eq. 3.1d)
c_M: Matter-coupling constant analogous to k_f, folded into M_op's own definition rather than tracked separately (defined in Eq. 1.3, Eq. 3.1d)
M_op_partial, S: An Artisan's partially diagonalized mass operator, and the finite eigenvector subset it's built from (defined in Eq. 3.1e)
lam_i, e_i: Eigenvalue/eigenvector pair of M_op; lam_i is solved exactly for e_i when e_i in S (defined in Eq. 3.1e / 4.16)
lam_guess, lam_true: Assumed vs. actual eigenvalue when a caster targets a material eigenvector outside S (defined in Eq. 4.17)
Effect_i: Magnitude of the quark-sector effect produced by drawing on eigenvector e_i (defined in Eq. 4.16)
dAe_local: The sourced ripple concentrated at the working site — the same quantity as Ae_local, written in §1.1's perturbation notation (defined in Eq. 4.16)
E_back_mat: Backlash energy absorbed when a caster targets an eigenvector outside S — the quark-sector form of E_back (defined in Eq. 4.17)
s: Direction parameter for Universal Binding & Decay Control: +1 to boost/hasten, -1 to weaken/arrest (defined in Eq. 4.19)
U_transmute(M_op_full): Unitary operator reassigning a quantity of matter's expression across the complete eigenbasis of M_op (defined in Eq. 4.18)
Xi_pert, eps: A Warden's perturbative expansion of Xi(Ae, g), and its departure-from-flat-space parameter (defined in Eq. 3.1f)
R_proven: A specific, previously-validated geometry to which a Warden confines an effect via Bump(r, R_proven) (defined in Eq. 4.20)
eps_valid(R_proven): The largest departure-from-flat-space eps that a given R_proven configuration has actually been demonstrated to tolerate (defined in Eq. 4.21)
E_back_pert: Backlash energy absorbed when eps is pushed past eps_valid(R_proven) — the perturbative-metric form of E_back (defined in Eq. 4.21)
R_dom, t_dom: Spatial radius and duration over which a solved Xi(Ae, g) remains valid — small for Sovereign, effectively permanent for Legend (defined in Eq. 3.1g)
t_dom_legend: The t_dom value at Legend scale — a standing duration (years to a generation) rather than a Sovereign's bounded hold (defined in Eq. 4.22 / 4.23 (scaling per Eq. 3.1g))
t_drift: Interval between re-validations of a destination's true conformal factor Om2(x) needed to keep mismatch(Om2) below G_dec's safe threshold (defined in Eq. 4.22)
t_recert: Max interval between Fid_shell re-inscriptions such that residual leak Curv_ext(r) stays below the ambient noise floor across t_dom_legend (defined in Eq. 4.23)
k_unified: Unsolved single coupling that would replace all four k_f terms at once (Tetrarch Path) (defined in §3.3)
Coh_tetrarch: Average of the six solved Chi(f1,f2) pairwise values; tends to 1 as k_unified is approached (never reached) (defined in Eq. 4.24)
Gen(dM): Unsolved generating structure for M_op, predicting rather than cataloguing eigenvectors (Demiurge Path) (defined in §3.3)
Gen_partial(dM), N_family: A proven, bounded extrapolation rule predicting new M_op eigenvectors from S, and the count of its verified predictions (defined in Eq. 4.25)
rho_cosmo, R_dom_legend_typical: Ratio of a caster's achieved domain to a typical Legend's domain, and the reference domain size it's measured against (Cosmographer Path) (defined in Eq. 4.26)
dM_total: Union of several casters' individually-proven comprehension domains (Communion Path) (defined in §3.3)
N_comm, dM_legend_typical: Ratio of a Communion's pooled dM_total to a typical Legend's dM, and that reference quantity (defined in Eq. 4.27)
Xi(Ae, g): Aether–spacetime coupling term (defined in Eq. 3.1b)
g: Spacetime metric (defined in Eq. 3.1a, Eq. 4.1)
dM: Boundary of the caster's comprehension domain (defined in Eq. 3.1)
X_ideal, X_eff: Theoretical output of a fully solved term, and the effective output actually produced — X_ideal scaled by Fid (defined in Eq. 3.2)
Fid: Fidelity coefficient — overlap between ideal and actual invocation (defined in Eq. 3.2)
phi_ideal, phi_actual: Ideal formal structure of a term vs. the caster's real-time invocation of it (defined in Eq. 3.2)
t_ins: Time invested in inscribing/invoking a term (defined in Eq. 3.2)
Fid_min: Minimum fidelity below which an invocation fails to manifest (defined in Eq. 3.3)
prac(x): Practice depth for a specific term x (defined in Eq. 3.4)
prac_min: Mastery threshold required for unassisted invocation (defined in Eq. 3.4)
anchor: 1 if a physical medium is used, 0 for pure mental visualization (defined in Eq. 3.4)
Step(...): Heaviside step function (defined in Eq. 3.4)
Sim[...]: Prefix operator: evaluates an invocation's readout without committing it to reality (defined in Eq. 3.5)
X_eff_proj: Projected effective output under Sim[...] — identical math to X_eff, never released (defined in Eq. 3.5)
E_back_proj: Projected backlash energy under Sim[...] — identical math to E_back, never released (defined in Eq. 3.5)
U_op(A, B): Unitary identification operator between two points (defined in Eq. 4.1)
Om2(x): Conformal scale factor reconciling two locations' metrics (defined in Eq. 4.1)
T_ae, T_mat: Stress-energy tensors, aether field vs. physical matter (defined in Eq. 4.2)
a(t), b(t): Amplitudes: "still at A" / "arrived at B" (defined in Eq. 4.3)
t_rel: Elapsed hold time at the moment the caster releases the fold — the counterpart to t_ins (defined in Eq. 4.5)
G_dec: Decoherence rate governing collapse safety (defined in Eq. 4.6)
eta: Proportionality constant setting how strongly conformal mismatch drives decoherence (defined in Eq. 4.6)
K(x): Knowledge coefficient for a given location (defined in Eq. 4.6)
s_int: External interference term (defined in Eq. 4.6)
E_back: Curvature-stress energy absorbed on failed collapse (defined in Eq. 4.7)
Curv(g): Curvature built from the metric (Einstein-tensor analogue) (defined in Eq. 4.8)
Bump(r, R): Smooth localization function, ~1 inside radius R, ~0 outside (defined in Eq. 4.8)
R_core: Radius of the well's core (true singularity/horizon region) (defined in Eq. 4.8)
Shell(r, R1, R2): Smooth annular support function, nonzero only between R1 and R2 (defined in Eq. 4.9)
R_shell: Outer containment radius — the intended edge of the well's influence (defined in Eq. 4.9)

k_newton: Fixed background constant governing how strongly mass-energy curves spacetime (a Newton's-constant analogue) — distinct from the solvable gauge coupling k_grav (Eq. 3.1c); no caster solves or scales it (defined in Eq. 4.10)
M_ae(r): Enclosed aether-mass-equivalent within radius r (defined in Eq. 4.10)
lapse(r): Proper-time rate at radius r relative to the exterior (defined in Eq. 4.10)
Fid_shell: Fidelity coefficient specific to the counter-curvature shell (Eq. 4.9) (defined in Eq. 4.11)
Curv_ext(r): Residual external curvature from an imperfectly contained well (defined in Eq. 4.11)
Ae_local: Locally concentrated aether density at a point of contact (defined in Eq. 4.0a)
P_in: Power injected into a target substance (defined in Eq. 4.0a)
m_obj, g_local: Mass of the object being lifted, and the local gravitational acceleration acting on it (defined in Eq. 4.0b)
F_net: Net downward force remaining after partial gravitational cancellation (defined in Eq. 4.0b)
E_bind, E_bind_eff: A material's ordinary binding energy, and its temporarily boosted value (defined in Eq. 4.0c)
Gamma_0, Gamma_eff: Baseline and weak-force-nudged decay rate of trace unstable material (defined in Eq. 4.0d)
P_out, E_per_decay, N_unstable: Radiant power produced by a nudged decay rate; energy released per decay event; count of unstable nuclei present (defined in Eq. 4.0d)
S_detect, dAe_nearby: Passive detection readout and the nearby ripple it reads, using the k_EM channel in reverse (defined in Eq. 4.0e)

Win_1(t), Win_2(t): Activation-window indicator functions (1 while a given solved k_f term is actively producing output, 0 otherwise); mutually exclusive at Journeyman tier since no Chi(f1,f2) exists to let one ripple satisfy both channels of Eq. 1.3 at once (defined in Eq. 4.13)

tau_switch: Dead time between two sequential Journeyman castings, spent re-inscribing or re-visualizing (§3.6); shrinks with drilled practice but cannot structurally reach zero without Chi (defined in Eq. 4.13)
Chi(f1, f2): Solved cross-coupling function joining two forces; absent at Journeyman tier, present at Adept (defined in Eq. 4.14)

t_hold: Sustain duration of a held (rather than discharged) casting — the interval over which a caster maintains J_cast and its resulting distortion, as distinct from t_ins, the time invested in the inscription itself (defined in Directory Expansion I (N-EM-06, N-EM-09, and throughout); mechanics per Eq. 3.2 / Eq. 1.2)

eta_<code>: A working form's shape factor: the dimensionless fraction (0 to 1) of a sourced distortion that the technique's usual target actually takes up, fixed by the target's geometry; eta = 1 recovers the base equation. Written with the entry's code, e.g. eta_NEM06 (defined in §8)
S_<code>: An Artisan entry's own solved eigenvector family, the S of Eq. 3.1e restricted to that entry's material (defined in §8, Eq. 4.16)
G_site: A Warden entry's site factor: the fraction of R_proven the surveyed geometry actually occupies, fixed by the survey and re-checked with it (defined in §8, Eq. 4.20)
D_cycle: Duty fraction of a held casting: the share of t_hold during which J_cast is actually sourced (defined in §8)
theta_arc: Half-angle of a directionally shaped distortion; the effect is present inside the arc and absent outside it (defined in §8)
T_pulse: Period of a pulsed casting; Win_p(t; T_pulse) is the pulse's activation window in the sense of Eq. 4.13 (defined in §8)
R_reach: Reach of a discharge or throw before the distortion falls below what the target can take; for a spark, V_out / V_break (defined in §8)
N_rep, w_1, w_2: A Journeyman round's repetition count and the live durations of its two windows; the round takes N_rep * (w_1 + w_2) + (2 N_rep - 1) * tau_switch (defined in §8, Eq. 4.13)
m_t, A_t: Mass and working area of a technique's target (defined in §8)
T_0, T_target, T_amb, T_eq: Starting, wanted, ambient and settled temperatures of a thermal working (defined in §8, Eq. 4.0a)
h_loss, h_vap: A target's heat loss to its surroundings per degree, and the heat needed to drive off a unit mass of water (defined in §8)
V_break: The potential at which a discharge crosses the gap to its target (defined in §8)
t_cure_0, t_spoil_0, t_reach: A process's unassisted curing or spoiling time, and the time a thermal working needs to reach T_target (defined in §8, Eq. 4.0d)
L_dom, v_survey: A standing work's domain length and the pace at which its order can re-survey it, whose ratio sets t_drift (defined in §8, Eq. 4.22)
Ae_0: The ambient, uniform, inexhaustible value of the aether field — inert on its own; never drawn down by a casting (defined in Eq. 1.1)
dAe, dAe(x, t): The local perturbation (ripple) superimposed on Ae_0 at the moment and place of a casting — the only part of the field that ever does anything (defined in Eq. 1.1)
J_cast, J_cast(x', t'): The source current the caster's invocation injects into the aether field — phi_actual in its role as a physical source (defined in Eq. 1.2)

Action: The aether action: L_total integrated over all of spacetime (defined in Eq. 3.1a)

Xi_valid: Where and when a solved Xi(Ae, g) remains valid: inside R_dom, before t_dom (defined in Eq. 3.1g)

X_seq: Total Journeyman output over time — a sum of non-overlapping contributions (defined in Eq. 4.13)
X_combo: An Adept's combined output from one ripple satisfying two gauge channels (defined in Eq. 4.15)
mismatch(Om2): Mismatch between the caster's assumed and the true conformal factor of the destination (defined in Eq. 4.6)
P_arrive: Probability of clean arrival at the moment a fold is released (defined in Eq. 4.5)
t_hold: Sustain duration of a held (rather than discharged) casting — distinct from t_ins (defined in §5.1)
